purpose: Redistributable 3D architectural entourage, building components, fixtures and unbranded furniture placeholders, generated with Meshy and normalised to real-world millimetre dimensions with authored Almond spatial contracts.

image_stage.prompt_suffix: Single object, isolated on a plain white background, three-quarter view from slightly above, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no text, realistic real-world proportions, clean architectural visualisation asset.

generation_recipe.post_process: tools/build_generated_assets.py normalises each GLB: scales uniformly to the catalogue height, re-centres bottom-centre on the origin, renames every material to ALMOND::<render_material_id>, measures bounds, writes manifest.json and one .almond.json contract per asset.

image_stage.prompt_suffix: Single tree, isolated on a plain white background, side view slightly from above, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no ground, no text, realistic proportions.

generation_recipe.batch_2_note: Batch 2 (2026-09-16) describes design language only - Scandinavian bent birch, American mid-century moulded plywood/shell, democratic design, Italian lighting - never brand or product names; ids and products stay generic so the CC BY 4.0 release is clean.
